components.title: Plugin V2 artifact identity and source route
components.summary: Connects the independently read back plugin artifact identity with the source path that compiles and transports the corrected engine pin.

flows.title: Corrected pin to rebuilt plugin heartbeat field

steps.description: Parse the full engine artifact digest from the configured pin.
Generate kEngineReleaseId and kEngineSha256 for compilation into the adapter.
Copy the compiled digest into coordinator client state.
Send the stored compiled digest in the coordinator heartbeat.

facts.statement: The corrected independent root receipt at 2026-10-01T03:38:22.486019+00:00 reports a successful plugin-only V2 rebuild from product 079396c and custody 202284d with Recoil 1ec00cf. The rebuilt libSkirmishAI.so has SHA-256 1685c183d73c55c493af1ca41b4fb0e1d0b6be245aa69fa981d7aaea182d9374 and contains release barc-fr5-peer-observer-1ec00cf plus engine artifact digest 80adf61a42fd2ff156b0d96e61e52ed596c9aa624b7d9f2d77d86c134a8f1301.

The same corrected receipt reports all 3,042 prior build6 manifest entries unchanged and all five actual adapter tests passing during the plugin-only rebuild. The focused qualification test artifact has SHA-256 62ead5582d2dcb0495135d1e26d844e6e426628a6916fd9afc40cb5598667452.

This outcome verifies a rebuilt artifact identity and adapter tests only. It does not show coordinator receipt, engine load, game execution, Count 1, 2, or 4 behavior, paired-peer agreement, callback/refund behavior, cleanup, or useful play. Native acceptance remains 0 of 6, the installed/current Recoil pointer remains 7555c83, and the predecessor afb1f06 plugin remains unadmitted.

open_questions: Will the receiver observe the rebuilt plugin's 80ad engine artifact digest on the first heartbeat?
Will protected native Count 1, 2, and 4 plus paired-peer lifecycle coverage pass with this artifact?
